options.name: --mtp-model
options.help: MTP draft model path for speculative decoding

options.name: --mtp-draft-vocab-prefix
options.help: Output rows the MTP draft head scores in place (default: 98304; fewer rows read less per draft token; the target still verifies over every row; needs --speculative mtp)

options.name: --mtp-draft-vocab-set
options.help: Token-ID list (one decimal ID per line) the MTP draft also scores above its prefix (needs --speculative mtp)

options.name: --vocab-trim-set
options.help: Token-ID list (one decimal ID per line) the target output head scores instead of every row; the special and stop tokens are always added and the draft reads the same rows (needs --speculative mtp; excludes --mtp-draft-vocab-prefix and --mtp-draft-vocab-set)

options.name: --vocab-trim-fallback-threshold
options.help: With --vocab-trim-set: re-run the full head for a position whose best probability over the scored rows is below P (default: 0.5; 0 never)

options.name: --vocab-trim-timing
options.help: With --vocab-trim-set: time the trimmed head's phases on the device and report them per request (head_trim_t_*)

options.name: --vocab-trim-counters
options.help: With --vocab-trim-set: count what the full-head fallback changes (argmax changes, unscored mass, discarded rows) and report it per request (head_trim_ctr_*)

options.name: --vocab-trim-discard-aware
options.help: With --vocab-trim-set and a fallback threshold above 0: do not pay a full-head read for chain rows that cannot be used. Greedy chains drop the flags after the first unflagged rejected draft token; other chains read a flagged row only when verification reaches it. Output unchanged

options.name: --vocab-trim-tier2
options.help: With --vocab-trim-set: re-score a flagged position over the first N token ids first, and re-run the full head only if the best probability over those and the scored tokens is still under --vocab-trim-tier2-threshold (default: off)

options.name: --vocab-trim-fallback-skip-scored
options.help: With --vocab-trim-set and a fallback threshold above 0: the full-head pass reads only the rows the scored set does not hold and keeps the scored values for the rest (not bit-identical to a full pass)

options.name: --vocab-trim-rowlog
options.help: With --vocab-trim-set: log every head call by call site (rows, sessions, flagged rows, verification rounds) and report it per request (head_trim_rowhist_*)

options.name: --vocab-trim-count-once
options.help: With --vocab-trim-set: report a batched decode step's head statistics to the first request that decoded instead of to every request of the batch (accounting only)
